column1: # unit-map.tsv -- explicit Delphi unit -> parallel lane assignment
# Read by tools/audit-coverage.ps1 (evidence E4).  A row means "a lane owns this unit and the
# VERDICT PRECEDENCE (updated 2026-09-21, ledger 45): VENDOR -> NONUNIT -> REFUTED -> MAPPED ->
# E4(ASSIGNED) -> WEAK -> CHECKLIST_ONLY -> UNMAPPED.  So a row does NOT by itself make a unit
# read as "assigned": if E1/E2 evidence exists the unit still reads MAPPED.  The report's
# ASSIGNED table therefore keys on "has an E4 row" (it shows the verdict too), which is what
# makes a STALE row visible instead of invisible.
# MANDATORY HYGIENE after every merge (ledger 38.2, applied three times already):
#   - port landed            -> DELETE the row (E1/E2 takes over);
#   - still unfinished       -> RE-ASSIGN to a live lane;
#   - not ported by design   -> move it to $VENDOR_UNITS / $E2_REFUTED in audit-coverage.ps1.
# A row left pointing at a MERGED+CLOSED lane is the worst case: the report then shows the unit
# Keys: "<unit>" matches EVERY copy with that basename; "<dir>/<unit>" matches that copy only.
# Use the per-copy form whenever the same basename also exists somewhere else with a DIFFERENT
# ruling or different bytes (see the sha256 column in the report's DUPLICATE-BASENAME section).
# REMOVED 2026-09-21 (round 57, ledger 45): 40 rows whose units had landed while their lane was
# already merged and closed -- the fourth batch of "permanently parked rows" (after ledger 38.2's
# 22, 41.10's 5, and the earlier P2/P3 sweep).  Re-measured on main: every one of them now reads
# MAPPED through E1/E2, so the rows only served to fake an in-flight set of 68 instead of 29:
#   par/p4-m2-objnpc         : ObjNpc                      (partially ported; its E2-only claim is
#   par/p2-rungate-impl      : RunGateUtils, IocpWinsock2, IocpUtils, IocpCommon, uBuffer,
#   par/p3-m2-sweep          : Nations, PowerBase64, MemoryModuleEx, GameGoldDealDB, HTTPService,
# IN FLIGHT (29 rows) -- live lanes only.
# ---- P10-db-login-forms (per-copy key on ThreadPool: only the LogDataServer copy is a real gap;
#      SelGate/LoginGate copies are registered as not-ported in audit-coverage.ps1) ----
# GLoginServerRouteSet row REMOVED 2026-09-21 (ledger 47.3-1): the unit was already ported --
# under the renamed class LoginServerRouteSetForm -- and its source-unit note sat at line 86 of
# GLoginServer.cs, outside the 40-line E2 window.  Moving that note to the header made the unit
# read MAPPED, so the row must go (a leftover row would re-park a finished unit).
# ---- P10-m2-misc (the last unowned product-UI units; basenames verified unique) ----
#      row removed).  GuiManage was ruled NOT PORTABLE with three independent proofs (original
#      references the non-existent TDxBackground; LoadDx already carries the job in evolved form;
#      a 1:1 port would need 13 out-of-zone seams) -> moved to $VENDOR_UNITS, NOT re-parked here.
# ---- P13 (round 59): ObjMon.pas was proven NOT ported (204 routines, 0 real implementations;
# the 46 ObjMon*Core.cs hold ~1,917 bare `=> true;`).  The unit stays in $E2_REFUTED (so it never
# reads MAPPED again) AND gets a lane row, so it is visible in both the REFUTED gap list and the
# in-flight table.  Do NOT register the other six refuted giants here until lanes exist for them.
